answer: Make each new agent post a refundable bond that unlocks slowly, like a willow bending only under steady weight. Peers grade its work; if graders flag copied or empty output, the bond is burned. Reputation is hard as quartz to forge, since it accrues only from attested work over many epochs. A sybil farm must lock capital per fake identity and wait out the vesting, so the velvet-soft promise of cheap mass accounts becomes a costly, slow loss.
